messages.settings.cloud.title: Cloud configuration backup
messages.settings.cloud.description: Save your complete configuration to your own cloud storage in encrypted form and restore it on other devices. Includes API keys, OAuth tokens, authentication headers, custom request bodies, and authentication parameters in URLs; excludes wordbooks, chat history, and usage statistics.
messages.settings.cloud.unavailable: Cloud backup requires the extension background. Use a local backup file in this environment.
messages.settings.cloud.downloadDescription: Replace this device’s settings and credentials with the configuration in {provider}.
messages.settings.cloud.uploadDescription: Save this device’s settings and credentials to {provider}, replacing the existing cloud configuration.
messages.settings.cloud.firstTitle: Save this device’s configuration to the cloud
messages.settings.cloud.selectedAccount: This sync uses your selected {provider} account.
messages.settings.cloud.connectionChanged: The sync connection changed. Generate a new preview.
messages.settings.webdav.passwordSaved: Saved; leave blank to keep it
messages.settings.webdav.passwordHint: Enter an app password for this service
messages.settings.webdav.connectionHint: Enter the full WebDAV URL of an existing directory. HTTPS and an app password are recommended. Connection settings stay on this device.
messages.settings.webdav.testSuccess: Connection test passed. No cloud files have been changed.
messages.settings.webdav.saveSuccess: Connection settings saved. You can start a cloud backup.
messages.settings.webdav.clearDescription: Clear the WebDAV URL, app password, and sync record on this device? Device configuration and cloud backup files will be kept.
messages.settings.webdav.httpWarning: HTTP does not encrypt network traffic. Others may read your connection credentials and backup.
messages.settings.webdav.httpConsent: I understand the risk and want to use this HTTP URL.
messages.settings.webdav.error.trusted: WebDAV cloud backup is only available from the extension settings page.
messages.settings.webdav.error.action: Invalid action. Reopen settings and try again.
messages.settings.webdav.error.url: Enter a full HTTP or HTTPS directory URL without credentials, query parameters, or fragments.
messages.settings.webdav.error.credentials: Enter a valid username and app password. Enter the password again when changing the URL or username.
messages.settings.webdav.error.insecure: This URL uses HTTP. Acknowledge the unencrypted transport warning first.
messages.settings.webdav.error.missing: Set up the WebDAV server and app password first.
messages.settings.webdav.error.changed: Connection settings changed in another page. Reopen connection settings.
messages.settings.webdav.error.auth: The username or app password is incorrect. Check it and try again.
messages.settings.webdav.error.forbidden: The server denied access. Check the directory’s read and write permissions.
messages.settings.webdav.error.notFound: The directory does not exist. Enter an existing WebDAV directory URL.
messages.settings.webdav.error.locked: Another device is using the backup file. Try again later.
messages.settings.webdav.error.quota: The server is out of storage space. Free space and try again.
messages.settings.webdav.error.conflict: The cloud backup changed. Generate a new preview.
messages.settings.webdav.error.etag: The server did not provide an ETag for safe updates. You can still restore an existing backup; use a service with conditional writes to save changes.
messages.settings.webdav.error.network: Cannot connect to the server. Check the URL, network, and certificate. If the URL redirects, enter the final WebDAV URL.
messages.settings.webdav.error.timeout: The server timed out. Check your network and try again.
messages.settings.webdav.error.tooLarge: The backup file is too large. Use a local backup file.
messages.settings.webdav.error.invalidDav: This URL did not return a valid WebDAV directory. Check that WebDAV is enabled.
messages.settings.webdav.error.http: The server request failed (HTTP {status}). Check the service and try again.
messages.settings.webdav.error.encryptedOnly: Only encrypted configuration within the size limit can be uploaded.
messages.settings.webdav.error.verify: The uploaded backup could not be verified. Generate a new preview and try again. Device configuration was not replaced.
messages.settings.webdav.error.decrypt: The backup could not be decrypted or is damaged. Device configuration was not changed.
messages.settings.webdav.error.failure: The operation did not finish. Check the network and local storage and try again.
messages.settings.cloud.privacyEncryption: Configuration is encrypted before upload. The app passphrase is public; account, directory, and device security provide the main protection.
messages.settings.cloud.privacyWebDavStorage: Accesses only the FluentRead backup under your chosen server directory.
messages.settings.cloud.privacyWebDavConnection: The connection password stays on this device. Server access requires a manual action.
